recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a purely editorial retitling of the multiple-values heading; the applied source already satisfies the substantive clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-33158 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search-page clarification, applied for R5, asking that AND and OR search-parameter combination behavior not be grouped under a "Composite Search Parameters" heading. It requested renaming the #combining section and removing misplaced introductory composite/$ sentences because AND and OR parameters are not composite parameters.
initial_application: The issue was applied by Jira-tagged commit 7553224a3289edc37b55479254c15c9db228d047, which moved the #combining anchor to the multiple-values section and rewrote the composite discussion. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-33158 commit was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: On the current combined branch, source/search.html keeps #combining immediately before "Searching Multiple Values (joining with AND or OR)" and explains AND/OR set logic there, while #composite remains a separate "Composite Search Parameters" section describing true $-joined composite tuples. Later search-page work preserved that separation. Zulip discussion supported the same confusion identified by the Jira issue, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source already removes the misleading placement that FHIR-33158 identified; changing the heading text exactly to "Combining Search Parameters" would be an editorial relabeling rather than a necessary correction to implementer understanding.
